Here's what ApolloSG's library says on this, from the sources below.
IDCARE — “Scammer Wants a Wife” (Supporting source · Australia · Apollo last checked it 24 October 2026):
The tried-and-true AusPost Scam:This scam has been around for quite some time, varying slightly to keep it fresh. It continues to be a focus for IDCARE clients. In February alone, over 20% of impersonation scam related cases referenced AusPost and almost $50,000 was lost. This scam comes in the form of either an email or an SMS link and may ask to verify details and delivery of anticipated packages. An SMS may say something along the lines of “to avoid the misplacement of your item verify and update your information as soon as possible via…” and a link to a fake AusPost website is provided. The scam can then prompt you to enter details including those required to facilitate a delivery payment.
